title: Recently played tags, clock, sharper playtime

cards.title: Recently played & Most played
cards.body:
Now that Shift keeps playtime, two tags build themselves: *Recently played* and *Most played*.

They behave like any other category tab. Hide or show them in *Settings > Library > Tag Manager*.

cards.title: A clock on the grid
cards.body: Turn it on in *Settings > Visuals > General*. It follows the time format Windows is already set to, so it matches the rest of the device.

cards.title: Playtime you can trust
cards.body: Shift now combines its own tracking with the records Steam and Epic already keep, and a session survives a restart instead of being lost.

cards.title: Dates and stores follow your region
cards.body:
Release dates and store regions across the catalogs now read your Windows regional settings instead of assuming one locale.

Steam release date lookups got faster too, and a game waiting on a patch carries an *Update available* badge.

cards.title: Games that need admin rights
cards.body: Apps and games that require administrator rights can now be launched from Shift instead of failing silently.

cards.title: And a pile of smaller things
cards.body:
A reworked menu focus colour for better visibility, rearranged button hints, battery and clock, plus performance work and bug fixes that did not need a card of their own.

Every earlier version has a deck of its own in *Settings > App Info > Feature Guide*.

changelog: New: Now that we have playtime data, we can have *Recently played* and *Most played* tags. As with the other tags, you can hide or show them in Settings > Library > Tag Manager.
New: Show clock option (Settings > Visuals > General). It follows your Windows time format.
Release dates and store regions in the catalogs now follow your Windows regional settings.
Playtime is more accurate. Shift combines its own tracking with the records Steam and Epic already keep, and a session survives a restart.
Steam games waiting on a patch now show an *Update available* badge.
Support for games and apps that need administrator rights.
Menu focus color reworked for better visibility.
Rearranged the positions of the button hints, battery and clock.
Several other performance improvements, bug fixes, and UI polish.
